transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, September 20. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'Negotiate or face decisive war': Iran sets 7 conditions to restart talks with US. Iran has officially presented seven demands to Washington for resuming negotiations, emphasizing the need to conclude hostilities and unfreeze assets. Alongside this diplomatic approach, Iran is readying itself for potential US military actions, adapting its military strategy to prioritize naval capabilities. Efforts are underway to swiftly resolve the ongoing conflict. As monsoon withdrawal begins, season may end with 10 percent deficit. 14 States Have Reported Rain Deficit Of More Than 20 percent So Far Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches. US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. Ken Griffey Jr.'s $2.5M Orlando estate now listed for $27m. Baseball legend Ken Griffey Jr. has placed his stunning lakeside mansion on the market for $27 million. Acquired in 2004, he dedicated four years to crafting this Mediterranean-style masterpiece, featuring seven luxurious bedrooms and ten bathrooms. The estate boasts exceptional amenities, including a private movie theater and a fun-filled saltwater pool complete with a waterslide. Ambulance stuck in mud, pregnant woman taken to hospital on bullock cart. A pregnant woman in Khargone district's Bhikangaon area was taken to hospital on a bullock cart and then a two-wheeler on Friday evening after a 108 ambulance got stuck in mud on a kutcha road. Alaska's largest recorded gold nugget, found in 1998, later sold for $750,000. In Alaska, a miner's incredible find of a massive gold and quartz specimen led to the unveiling of the largest gold nugget ever discovered in the state. Weighing over twenty pounds, this extraordinary piece, known as the Alaska Centennial Nugget, was held in a private collection until it hit the auction block in 2021, where it fetched an impressive $750,000. In a first, abetment FIR filed against IIT-Bombay professor in 2nd-year student's death. In possibly the first such instance, an IIT-Bombay professor was named an accused in connection with a student's death by suicide on campus on Saturday. Johnny Carson's Malibu estate once asked $81.5m, finally sold for $40m. Johnny Carson's iconic Malibu estate has embarked on quite a price adventure. Initially acquired for around nine point five million dollars, the property was later listed at eighty-one point five million dollars. It ultimately sold for forty million dollars in 2019 and has now returned to the market, boasting a staggering price tag of one hundred ten million dollars. PM Modi pushes back on West's narrative over emissions. PM Narendra Modi Saturday questioned the narrative in which the responsibility for carbon emissions is pinned on developing countries while Western countries are absolved of their role as historical polluters, even as he reaffirmed the country's commitment to climate action and stressed that it has the best record among G20 countries. US military says it struck suspected drug-trafficking vessel, 4 killed. The US military said it killed four people in a strike on a vessel in the Caribbean on Saturday, alleging that it was involved in drug trafficking. UPI MDR: Can rupees 6,000 be split into three rupees 2,000 payments? No daily cap. The NPCI framework and the FAQs issued with it do not stipulate that multiple payments relating to a single bill must be clubbed together. Such a restriction, if in place, could prevent businesses from breaking up larger payments into multiple transactions of rupees 2,000 or less. ASI Harjit Singh murdered: Key suspect shot dead in police encounter in Amritsar. In a major breakthrough in the probe into the killing of on-duty ASI Harjeet Singh, Amritsar Police shot dead one of the alleged suspects in an encounter on Saturday night.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. NCISM Denies Permission To Nine Private Ayurvedic Colleges In Madhya Pradesh. The NCISM has reportedly denied permission to nine private Ayurvedic colleges in Madhya Pradesh for the 2026–27 academic session over regulatory and infrastructure deficiencies. Gen Z Becomes New Political Focus Ahead of 2028 Madhya Pradesh Elections. Gen Z has emerged as a major political focus in Madhya Pradesh, with senior leaders attending youth events and the government announcing scholarships, AI training and recruitment programmes. Bhopal Power Cut September 20: Power To Remain Disrupted In Patel Nagar D-Sector, Raisen Road, Vardhman Green City, Rajiv Nagar B And C Sectors and More; Check Full List. Power supply will be disrupted in several localities in Bhopal on September 20 due to departmental work. Madhya Pradesh Sanctions rupees 600 Crore For High-Tech Simhastha Security In Ujjain. The Madhya Pradesh government has sanctioned rupees 600 crore for security arrangements during the Ujjain Simhastha. Three Blade Attacks In 24 Hours Leave Three Injured, Raise Patrolling Concerns In Bhopal. Three people were seriously injured in separate knife and sword attacks across Bhopal within 24 hours, intensifying concerns over police patrolling. PM condoles the loss of lives in mishap in Agar Malwa, Madhya Pradesh. EPFO Says Higher rupees 25,000 Wage Ceiling Will Expand Social Security Coverage. EPFO's Indore regional office said the wage ceiling for mandatory provident fund coverage had increased from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000 a month, bringing more employees under the scheme. After Sagar tragedy, Madhya Pradesh Police uncover hooch racket with Delhi link. Technology And Indian Heritage Must Shape Education, Says Swami Avadheshanand In Ujjain. Swami Avadheshanand Giri called for education combining technological innovation with India's scriptural heritage during an interaction in Ujjain. Fr. Alexander Appointed Chaplain of YCS/YSM. Property tax 'racket' in BMC portal: School's tax slashed, case lodged. Sunday MP monsoon update: State gets 90.3 percent of seasonal quota, still 'below normal'; over half districts fac. Ujjain Mayor Calls Off Protest After CM Mohan Yadav's Assurance In Roadshow Row. Ujjain Mayor Mukesh Tatwal withdrew his proposed protest after Chief Minister Mohan Yadav assured action over an incident in which Tatwal was asked to step down from a chariot during BJP president Nitin Nabin's roadshow. Former IPS officer booked over allegedly fake ST certificate in Madhya Pradesh. Madhya Pradesh govt 'terrified' of 'Chhatron ki Goonj': Congress ahead of Rahul's Indore event. CM Mohan Yadav Urges Youth To Learn Courage From Ram And Friendship From Krishna In Ujjain. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav urged young people to draw lessons in courage, friendship and resilience from Lord Ram and Lord Krishna at the Yuva Dharm Sansad in Ujjain. President Murmu, Odisha CM mourn seven Odia tourists killed in MP accident. Seven of a family from Odisha among eight killed as car falls into drain in Madhya Pradesh. UPI MDR may raise freight costs, disrupt truck operations, transporters warn. Three-year-old Botswanan female cheetah to join African big cats at MP's Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. ITC stock: 360 ONE maintains BUY, sees 68 percent upside; here's why brokerage is bullish. ITC navigates weakened cigarette volumes due to tax changes but is offsetting losses with price hikes and improving margins. 360 ONE maintains a BUY rating, predicting an upside of 68 percent with a target price of rupees 440 per share despite a 35 percent stock decline last year. India's exports of software services up by 8.2 percent in FY26 to US$ 221.4 billion. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) released the data related to the 2025-26 round of its annual survey on computer software and information technology enabled services (ITES) exports. For 2025-26 round of the survey, 7,569 software export companies were contacted, of which 2,363 companies, including most of the large companies, responded. RBI stated that India's exports of software services (excluding their sales through overseas commercial presence) increased by 8.2 per cent (y-o-y) during 2025-26 to US$ 221.4 billion. IPO GMP compared: SS Retail, Hero Motors, Jindal Supreme - allotment soon, how to check status online, subscription. The Jindal Supreme IPO achieved 177x subscription, raising rupees 124.88 crore. The allotment status can be checked via BSE, NSE, or Bigshare. Hero Motors and SS Retail IPOs also saw strong interest, with substantial subscription figures and their allotment status available online. Hy-Tech Engineers posts PAT of rupees 4.6 crore for Q1; board OKs business expansion plans. Hy-Tech Engineers has reported 10.8 percent rise in standalone net profit to rupees 4.60 crore on a 12.9 percent increase in revenue to rupees 41.26 crore in Q1 FY27 as compared with Q1 FY26. Top stocks to buy under rupees 200: Castrol, NHPC, Vikram Solar - 3 shares by Anand Rathi's Mehul Kothari; target, stop-loss. Kothari warns that a close below 55,500 may lead to increased selling pressure. He sees 57,000 as a key resistance for Bank Nifty. Recommended stocks under rupees 200 include Castrol India, NHPC, and Vikram Solar, with specific targets and stop losses provided. Hazoor Multi Projects bags work contract worth rupees 207 crore. Hazoor Multi Projects said that it has has received Work Order from Emerald Haven Life Spaces 3 (EHLS3PL) for a project worth rupees 207.44 crore. Salesforce stock falls over 8 percent in 4 sessions despite $63 bn revenue target, but UBS raised outlook price - Here's why. Salesforce aims for $63 billion in revenue by fiscal 2030, surpassing analyst estimates. UBS has increased its price target for Salesforce but cut its fiscal 2028 growth forecast, citing potential challenges in revenue momentum due to AI competition and adoption uncertainties. Maruti Suzuki launches automatic S-CNG models of Swift, Dzire and Baleno. Maruti Suzuki India has launched the Auto Green Mission with the introduction of the automatic S-CNG models for the popular Swift, Dzire and Baleno. Designed for new-age customers who refuse to compromise, the new range of Maruti Suzuki automatic S-CNG range of cars offer automatic car driving convenience with superior fuel-efficiency, making the Dzire automatic S-CNG India's most fuel-efficient sedan# with a fuel efficiency of 36.47km/kg. Nestle India issues clarification: Why FMCG stock plunged? What's FSSAI baby formula row; why it matters to consumers?. FSSAI has launched three adjudication cases against Nestle India for compliance issues with its infant nutrition products. Despite recent stock pressure, Nestle maintained that its products comply with regulations and that all disclosures were timely made to the stock exchanges. NIBE Group signs MoU with Naval Group, France. To collaborate on modern technologies for India's naval programs Small-cap stock under rupees 50: Kellton Tech in focus next week due to fundraise meeting - Check date. Kellton Tech Solutions, after achieving rupees 27.27 in September 2025, plans to explore fundraising methods in a board meeting on September 23, 2026. The stock has seen a continuous downtrend, losing 50 percent of its value in the last year. Apollo Pipes forays into ceramic tiles segment. With acquisition of 76 percent stake in Mazzini Tiles LLP for consideration of rupees 40.42 cr Top stocks to buy on Monday: Sumeet Bagadia recommends 3 stocks HDFC Bank, Adani Ports, JSW Steel - targets, stop-loss. Benchmark stock indices showed mixed results; Sensex dipped 0.03 percent while Nifty gained 0.33 percent . Crude oil prices fell, impacting markets. Analysts expect recovery hinges on easing global risks. Recommended stocks include HDFC Bank, Adani Ports, and JSW Steel for bullish trading strategies. Godrej Properties constructs 24-mtr wide government road near Godrej Aristocrat. Improving infrastructure network in Gurugram Four aerospace stocks to watch as India builds its MRO industry. Tax cuts and other policy changes are making India's aircraft maintenance market more attractive, but listed exposure remains limited and mostly indirect. Cryogenic OGS secures first export order under its piping spools segment. The order, valued at USD 2,022,816 (approximately rupees 19.36 crore), has been placed by a Global EPC Company that specializes in bulk liquid storage terminals, refineries, and oil and gas process plants. Execution is scheduled to be completed within 12-20 weeks. Indian creators eye China's Bilibili. Small Indian creators have started posting on China's Bilibili, often called China's YouTube, using workarounds such as VPNs and changed location settings, even though the platform has not launched in India and the country is not among its listed international markets. Nepal PM likely to visit India by year end. Nepalese Prime Minister Balen Shah plans his first India visit by year-end. Rossell Techsys to raise rupees 300 crore from SBI Mutual Fund, SBI Optimal Equity Fund. Rossell Techsys said that its board approved a proposal for the issuance of 25.72 lakh fully paid-up equity shares for a total consideration of rupees 299.99 crore, on a private placement basis, to SBI Mutual Fund and SBI Optimal Equity Fund. F-35 parts meant for US land in China: Report. F-35 parts diverted to Hong Kong: Sensitive components of the US-made F-35 fighter jet were reportedly diverted to Hong Kong while being shipped from Australia to the US for repairs, prompting an investigation and congressional briefings over concerns about potential exposure of sensitive technology. Apollo Pipes arm buys 76 percent stake in Mazzini Tiles. Apollo Pipes said its subsidiary, Apollo Ceramics acquired a 76 percent controlling stake and profit-sharing rights in Mazzini Tiles for rupees 40.42 crore to expand its tiles and ceramics business. 6 adulterants used in Tirupati laddoo: ED. The Tirupati laddu ghee adulteration case has taken a fresh turn with the Enforcement Directorate (ED) alleging that ghee supplied to the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) was manufactured using refined palm oil, palmolein, palm kernel oil and various chemicals, and passed off as Agmark Special Grade Cow Ghee. NTPC Green Energy adds 9.45 MW commercial capacity at Kutch, Gujarat. The current commercial capacity of NTPC Green Energy Limited group stands at 10,911.08 MW. With the addition of the above, the total installed capacity of the NTPC Green Energy Group will increase to 10,920.53 MW. How it's rewarding to break your trust fund. The video assistant referee system in football has revealed notable blunders in officiating, calling into question our confidence in third-party expertise. Mazagon Dock inks MoU for greenfield shipbuilding cluster in Andhra Pradesh. Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders (MDL) has entered into an MoU with National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park Andhra Pradesh (NSHIPAP) to serve as the anchor shipyard for the proposed greenfield shipbuilding industrial cluster at Dugarajapatnam. Aichi-Nagoya: India's burdens to bear. With Neeraj Chopra out of the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya with an ankle injury, javelin throwers Rohit Yadav and Yashvir Singh will compete under the pressure of his shadow, even as Anju Bobby George predicts India's track and field contingent will cross 30 medals. HEG arm bags rupees 217-cr order from Indus Towers. HEG announced that its subsidiary, Replus Engitech, has received an order from Indus Towers for the supply of lithium-ion battery banks. Railways approves multiple infra projects. Railways has approved multiple infrastructure and safety projects across the country, including Kavach 4.0 installation on 607.7 route kilometres in Lucknow Division at rupees 252 crore, Electronic Interlocking at seven Solapur Division stations for rupees 209 crore, a 1x25 kV to 2x25 kV traction upgrade on the Savalyapuram-Guntur section for rupees 142 crore, and a four-lane road overbridge in Gujarat costing rupees 133.2295 crore. Shilpa Medicare Unit VII inspection ends with one procedural observation. Shilpa Medicare said the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) conducted a surveillance inspection at Unit VII of its Analytical Services Division in Hyderabad from 16 to 18 September 2026. Canada hopeful of India trade deal by year-end. Canada anticipates finalizing a comprehensive economic partnership agreement with India by year's end.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Higher EPS pension: Ruling party MP urges PM Modi to ensure uniform, time-bound implementation. BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ajeet Madhavrao Gopchade has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to intervene in pending higher EPS pension issues. He highlighted procedural hurdles under Para 26(6), continuing litigation, pending Parliamentary Assurance No. 271/72, financial sustainability concerns and differing pension treatment among trust employees. He sought uniform implementation, faster disposal of eligible claims and a comprehensive review of EPS-1995. Price range, ready-to-move or under construction, 1, 2, or 3BHK , Check here for what homebuyers prefer. The residential sector in India is supported by strong demand and lifestyle aspirations. A Colliers report indicates resilient housing sales, driven by long-term homeownership and selective purchasing amid affordability concerns. Income Tax Rules 2026 amended: CBDT revises Form 169, Form 171; extends these deadlines. The Central Board of Direct Taxes has rolled out significant amendments to income tax regulations for 2026, particularly affecting electronic communication and tax recovery processes. The deadlines for registering valuers and income tax professionals have been pushed back, allowing applicants until March 31, 2027, to finalize their registrations. E-commerce platforms Eternal's Zomato, Blinkit, Meesho's Valmo facilitate ITR refunds for delivery partners, What we know. Eternal's Zomato and Blinkit, and Meesho's Valmo have facilitated ITR for over 2 lakh delivery partners, unlocking rupees 35.6 crore combined in refunds. Over 70 percent of filers were first timers, the companies added. 5 Bangalore landowners formed a partnership firm to develop property, received income tax notice for undisclosed rental income; won relief in ITAT for this reason. Bangalore landowners get relief from undisclosed rental income tax notice after proving in ITAT that their partnership firm received the rent. What happened was, five Bangalore landowners signed JDA with builder, later formed partnership firm to develop property; but then the landowners got undisclosed rental income tax notice. Unlimited health insurance explained: Exclusions, waiting periods - 5 things you must check before buying a policy. The actual protection available depends on the terms and conditions of the policy, including its coverage, exclusions, waiting periods, deductibles, co-payments and sub-limits OneTag launched for FASTag users: You can now change issuer bank without replacing your FASTag; what will happen to your existing wallet?. In a game-changing move for FASTag users, the newly launched 'OneTag' portability feature enables individuals to transition their issuer bank without losing their current physical tag. This innovative service mandates a fresh Know Your Customer verification to initiate the portability. Subsequent to the successful switch, the initial bank will deactivate the old wallet and refund any remaining balance. No more currency conversion, gaming platform Roblox to launch wallet to pay creators , What we know. Gaming platform Roblox is set to launch its own digital wallet to pay creators and facilitate easier and quicker payment, compared to the present requirement where virtual currency Robux is converted into dollars, which leads to long payment delays. Homebuyer caught in builder-housing society parking fight wins relief: Know what Maharashtra court ruled. Homebuyer caught between builder and housing society dispute over parking space and open area; Maharashtra Court protects buyer's parking rights. Read the article to know how. Travelling abroad? Here's full list of foreign countries with UPI facility availability for Indian tourists. Wider acceptance of UPI abroad benefits Indian tourists, students and business travelers by allowing use familiar mobile apps for payments instead of reliance on international debit or credit cards.
